versions.subject: Rule: Sysmon Malware Shellcode in Verclsid Process
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 10
    TargetImage: '*\verclsid.exe'
    GrantedAccess: '0x1FFFFF'
combination1:
    CallTrace: '*|UNKNOWN(*VBE7.DLL*'
combination2:
    SourceImage: '*\Microsoft Office\*'
    CallTrace: '*|UNKNOWN*'
condition: selection and ( combination1 or combination2 )
versions.spl: EventID=10 TargetImage="*\\verclsid.exe" GrantedAccess="0x1FFFFF" CallTrace="*|UNKNOWN(*VBE7.DLL*" OR (SourceImage="*\\Microsoft Office\*" CallTrace="*|UNKNOWN*")
